27.original: Stand at the destination and examine the murals.

48.original: The bag is sealed tight, but I'd rather not keep the bees buzzing about in there longer than we have to.

49.original: The Children's settlement is to the west, a place they call Woven Oath.

50.original: According to the guard, there is an airway apart from the entrance which leads to the spiders' nests.

51.original: If the fates are kind, the way will be clear.

52.original: We should move quickly, before any of the Children arrive.

53.original: Up there is the airway. Do you see it?

54.original: A bit far, perhaps, but we should be able to toss the bag through.

55.original: Though we should probably loosen the ropes keeping it closed. Enough that it falls open when it lands inside.

57.original: That should do it. Now we wait...

58.original: (-Villager of the Everlasting Dark-)What is that!?

59.original: (-Villager of the Everlasting Dark-)Bees! By the abyss, they're everywhere!

60.original: (-Villager of the Everlasting Dark-)Help! Someone help! We have to save the spiders!

61.original: It sounds like our plan is working.

62.original: Still, it is quite likely not all were drawn away from their posts.

63.original: If you should come to blows with the Children, I'll see to it any signs of struggle are concealed. Failing that, I'll create a distraction to buy Y'shtola more time.

64.original: Should anyone get past me, it falls to you to guard her.

65.original: Your concern is appreciated, but I sincerely doubt it will come to that.

66.original: Why do I get the feeling you enjoy the idea of my loafing about bored in the shadows?

67.original: Come now, Thancred. The shadows are a fitting place for a <hex:021A020203>Warrior of Darkness<hex:021A020103>. Now, if you both are ready?

68.original: Go on. I'll be right behind you.

69.original: The Font of Seeing suggests this is a chamber for prayer. At the very least, they would not place this near potential distractions from their worship.

70.original: Perhaps the monument is further in.

72.original: I will be but a moment. Keep watch of the entryway.

73.original: On second thought, would you mind examining the murals on these walls while I look over this?

74.original: At a glance, I can tell they are old. Predating the founding of the Blessed and the Children, in fact.

75.original: We're not like to come here a second time. 'Twould behoove us to learn all that we can.

76.original: Hmmm... Then what does this mean...?

77.original: Examine the murals and take note of what events they may depict. You may move the camera as well as zoom in and out. Target a mural and examine it with <hex:020825E4E95101FF10024804F2022203EE81910248020103FF0E021E021003202F20021E02090303>.

78.original: Good to see my distraction proved successful.

79.original: I believe I now have everything needed to finish deciphering the tablet.

80.original: Tell me, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, did the murals appear to be of any significance?

81.original: Depictions of heroes? From the age of gods, the Ronkan Empire, and immediately before the Flood.

82.original: Very astute observations. Perhaps in another lifetime you could be a curator of antiquities.

83.original: Though it has no bearing on the task at hand, perhaps that knowledge may prove to be of use in the future.
